Card Scanner help guide

Greater Akron Chamber · business-card scanner pilot · for the data team and scanner admins

Pilot guide, updated Oct 14, 2026 (round 16). It describes the pilot as it is today. Open the printable PDF. All screenshots use made-up demo cards (fictional people, 555 phone numbers).

New in rounds 9–11: a merge is always made from the card you are on into the card you pick (it is cancelled if you move to another card while its dialog is open), and the preview says replace when a misread email is swapped for the good one. The review page warns Already exported when the same person was approved and exported in another batch. Cards with any look-alike or MC Trade match never show Looks good. The AI double-check is a spelling/typo double-check, advisory only: compare every field to the photo. Add back of card only adds an email or website that is printed on the back (and a website only when it matches the card's email). The footer shows the app version and commit. Admin → Settings warns when backups are on the same disk as the data.

New in round 8: the queue remembers your batch filter and opens on your batch; "Select all" and the bulk dialogs pick your cards first and say whose cards are included (the dialog's default button is Cancel). Next after Approve stays in the card's batch, and All done appears only when that batch has no pending card left. The card shows an Unsaved changes badge and a Discard my edits button; saving or signing out clears drafts. The reasons a card needs checking are shown on the fields and in a list at the top of the card. Look-alikes have one decision per card ("Your decision for this card"). Batch names are kept exactly as you type them. The MC Trade export, its sign-off and the dry run use one shared decision per card (new / update / needs review / left out).

1. What the Card Scanner does

The Card Scanner turns photos of business cards into a checked contact list that you can import into MC Trade. It runs on one office computer. Card photos and contact details are never sent to the internet: there is no cloud service and no outside AI company, and nothing goes to MC Trade until a person exports a file and imports it.

The work always follows the same six steps:

Step What happens Who
1. Scan Add photos of the cards from one event (one batch). Anyone with an account
2. Review Compare each card's details with its photo and fix anything wrong. Reviewer
3. AI double-check (optional; spelling/typo, advisory) A small AI model on the same computer re-reads hard cards and suggests spelling fixes. It is advisory: compare every field to the photo. Automatic; you accept or ignore
4. Duplicates Decide whether a card is the same person as another card, or someone already in MC Trade. Reviewer
5. Approve / reject Approve good cards; reject cards you don't want. Reviewer
6. Export Download the MC Trade Excel file (or CSV / vCard) and import it into MC Trade. Reviewer exports; an MC Trade admin imports

Roles

Role Can do
Reviewer Scan, review, approve and reject, export approved cards (all, or one batch), add the back of a card, undo their own actions.
Admin Everything a reviewer can, plus: add and deactivate accounts, reset passwords, change settings, read the audit log, archive batches, export pending/all/rejected cards, delete a card permanently (removal requests), and archive all test data.

2. Starting the scanner

This part is for the person who looks after the scanner computer.

2.1 First-time installation (once, about 15 minutes)

  1. Install Python 3 from https://www.python.org/downloads/. On Windows, tick "Add python.exe to PATH" in the installer.
  2. Install Tesseract, the card-reading engine:
    • Mac: install Homebrew (https://brew.sh), then type brew install tesseract in Terminal.
    • Windows: run the installer from https://github.com/UB-Mannheim/tesseract/wiki and keep the default folder.
  3. Unzip gac-card-scanner-pilot.zip somewhere permanent, for example Documents.
  4. Double-click start.command (Mac) or start.bat (Windows). The first start installs components and takes a few minutes.
    • Mac: if it says the file "can't be opened", right-click it, choose Open, then Open again.
  5. Your browser opens http://localhost:8765/ui. The first time it shows First-time setup: type your full name, initials, a username and a password (at least 10 characters) twice, then click Create admin and sign in.
    • First-time setup only works on the scanner computer itself, not from another computer or a phone.
  1. Go to Admin → Reviewers and add an account for each person on the data team (see section 12.1).

2.2 Every day

  1. Double-click start.command / start.bat. It takes about 10 seconds. If the scanner is already running, it just opens the browser.
  2. Keep the black window open while anyone is working. Closing it stops the scanner for everyone.
  3. The address is http://localhost:8765 on the scanner computer.

Note: the black window says whether the AI double-check is online. If it says "AI checker OFFLINE", scanning still works; see section 7.5.

2.3 Optional: the AI double-check

The AI double-check needs extra model files (about 3 GB, not in the zip). If IT has set them up, double-click start-ai-checker.command in a second window and leave it open too. Without it, cards are only read the fast way and nothing else changes.

2.4 Optional: phone access

Phones can scan cards with their camera over the office Wi-Fi. Nothing needs to be set up first:

  1. In the scanner, open Scan cards and choose Scan with phone. A QR code appears.
  2. Scan it with the phone (same office Wi-Fi). The phone opens a page for this batch only; the link works once and expires after 15 minutes.
  3. Windows may ask about the firewall the first time: allow Private networks only (port 8766).

The old enable-phone-access scripts are retired. Phone mode does not work when the scanner runs in Docker as shipped (the phone port isn't published and the container's address isn't the computer's); use the normal start scripts for phone scanning.

2.5 Stopping and backing up

  • Stop: close the black window.
  • Automatic backup: while it runs, the scanner makes a backup every night at 02:30 (or soon after it starts, if the computer was off at night) and keeps the last 7. Each backup is one file, backups/gac-backup-<date>-<time>.tgz, with the database (copied safely while running), card photos, stored exports and the template. The MC Trade contacts export is never in a backup. To keep backups on another disk (recommended: a USB drive or a synced folder), start the scanner with GAC_BACKUP_DIR set to that folder. Make one now with scripts/backup.sh.
  • Restore: stop the scanner, then run scripts/restore_backup.sh to list the backups and scripts/restore_backup.sh backups/gac-backup-….tgz to restore one (type YES). The backup is checked first; the current data folder is moved aside to data.before-restore-<time> (nothing is deleted) and the uploaded MC Trade contacts file is kept. Start the scanner again afterwards.
  • Keep backups no longer than 30 days and store them as securely as the computer itself.

3. Signing in

  1. Open http://localhost:8765 (or the phone address).
  2. Type your username and password and click Sign in.
  • First sign-in: an admin gives you a temporary password. The scanner asks you to choose your own (at least 10 characters).
  • Change your password any time with Password in the top bar.
  • Wrong password 5 times? Sign-in pauses for 5 minutes. An admin can lift the pause straight away by resetting your password.
  • You stay signed in for 12 hours of inactivity. Click Sign out when you leave a shared computer.
  • Use your own account and your own browser (or browser profile). Your initials are saved on every card you edit, approve or export. If someone else signs in in the same browser, any open scanner tabs show a red warning: reload before doing anything else.
  • If the page says "Already signed in" as someone else, click Sign out and sign in as someone else.

4. Scanning cards

4.1 Before you scan

  • One card per photo. Lay the card flat on a dark, plain surface, fill the frame, and avoid glare.
  • JPG or PNG photos work. Photos from a phone camera are fine.
  • Keep one batch per event. Batches let you review, export and archive one event at a time.

4.2 Scan a batch from the computer

  1. Click Scan cards in the top bar.
  2. Type a name in Name this batch, for example Oct 15 Business After Hours. The scanner adds the date, time and your initials, e.g. "Oct 15 Business After Hours · Oct 15, 6:30 PM · JS".
    • If you use the same batch name again within 12 hours, the new photos join that batch (the screen says "Added to your existing batch").
  3. Add the photos in any of these ways:
    • Drag and drop: drag photos, or a whole folder, onto the dashed box. The box turns orange when you can let go.
    • Choose photos: pick one or many photos (Ctrl+A / ⌘A selects all in a folder).
    • Choose a folder: pick a folder; every photo in it is added.
    • Folder button doesn't open? Open the folder with Choose photos and select all, or drag the folder onto the box.

4.3 Watching the batch

Cards are read one after another: about 2–5 seconds each when you're the only one scanning, 5–30 seconds when others are scanning too. The screen shows the time left. You can start reviewing finished cards while the rest are being read.

When a card is finished its row shows the person's name and card number (for example ✓ Maria Delgado (#103)) and one of these tags:

Tag Meaning
Looks good Nothing special to check (you still review it).
Check Something needs a second look on the review screen (hard-to-read field, possible duplicate…).
Not added The file was skipped. The reason is shown underneath.

Reasons a file is Not added: Not a photo, File is empty, Photo is too small, looks blank, or already scanned. An already scanned photo says who scanned it, when, and which card it became: click Open card #… to see it. If you really want a second copy, click Scan it anyway.

When the batch is done, click Review this batch →. Start a new batch clears the list for the next event.

QR codes: if a card has a QR code with contact details, the scanner reads it automatically. Those fields are tagged from QR code and are almost always right.

4.4 Scanning with a phone

After phone access is turned on (section 2.4), sign in on the phone and open Scan cards. The phone shows Take a photo as well as Choose photos. Take one photo per card; each photo is added to the batch straight away.

  • iPhones can't pick a whole folder; select photos instead.
  • The review screens also work on a phone, but reviewing is easier on a computer.

5. The review queue

Click Review queue in the top bar. The orange number next to it is the number of pending cards for the whole team.

  • Tabs: Pending / Approved / Rejected / All, with counts.
  • Batch: pick an event, or type in Find a batch… to search the list.
  • Needs attention only: cards with a problem to look at. The reasons are in words, e.g. Name is required, Hard to read: Address, May be the same person as card #106, May already be in MC Trade: James Okafor.
  • Possible duplicates: only cards that may be a duplicate.
  • Not yet exported: approved cards that haven't gone into an export yet.
  • Search: name, company, email, file name, or #12 for card 12.
  • Confidence: how sure the reader was (green = high, orange/red = check carefully).
  • Status: Pending / Approved / Rejected, plus tags such as AI checking…, AI suggestions, AI-checked, Archived or exported.
  • Your filters stay when you refresh the page.

Click a row (or a name) to open the card.

5.1 Bulk approve or reject

  1. Tick the cards (or the box at the top of the list to tick all shown).
  2. Click Approve selected or Reject selected and confirm.

Cards that still need fixing, or that have an open duplicate question, are skipped and listed. Bulk approve never lets a problem through. If some ticked cards were already decided, the scanner asks whether to change them too.

6. Reviewing a card

The photo is on the left and the editable details are on the right.

6.1 Step by step

  1. Compare every field with the photo. Click Enlarge (or the photo) to zoom; Open original opens the full photo in a new tab.
  2. Fix anything wrong by typing in the field.
    • Emails: separate several with commas.
    • Phones: one per line, with a type: work: 330-555-0100, mobile: …, fax: ….
    • Yellow fields (marked Please check) were hard to read: look at them carefully.
  3. Read any boxes at the top of the form:
    • Possible duplicate (orange): see section 8.
    • AI suggestions (blue): see section 7.
    • Details that don't agree with each other: for example the email domain doesn't match the website, or the phone area code doesn't match the state. These are hints, not errors.
  4. Click Approve (or press A) or Reject (or press R). Your edits are saved at the same time. The scanner moves on to the next card.

Field tags

Tag Meaning
(no tag) Read from the printed text on the card.
from QR code Read from the card's QR code: very reliable.
corrected by AI You accepted an AI suggestion: please confirm it.
from the back of the card Filled in from the back photo.
edited by XX Changed by the person with those initials.

6.2 What approval checks

Approve checks the card first. If something is wrong, a box lists all the problems at once and the fields turn red.

Must be fixed (no way round it) Can be fixed, or approved anyway with a reason
A blank first name Other email or phone problems the scanner is unsure about
An email without "@" (e.g. name@@) A card with neither an email nor a phone
A phone with fewer than 7 digits
Text that a spreadsheet could run as a formula (starting with =, +, - or @) or HTML code in a contact field

For the right-hand column you can click Approve anyway and type a reason. The reason is saved, and the row is flagged in the export (NeedsAttention) so the importer checks it.

6.3 Other buttons on the review screen

  • Save changes: saves your edits without approving or rejecting.
  • Move back to pending: undoes a decision on an approved or rejected card. (A rejected card has no Approve button: move it back to pending first, then approve.)
  • Delete permanently… (admins only): for removal requests, see section 13.
  • ← Prev / Next → and ↩ Queue: move through the same list you opened the card from.
  • Add back of card…: add a photo of the back. Only empty fields are filled from it. If the back shows a different person's name, the scanner asks before adding anything.
  • Text read from the card: the raw text the reader saw.
  • History: who scanned, edited, approved, exported or undid what, and when (notes too).

Editing an approved card (or merging another card into it) checks it again. If it no longer passes, it goes back to pending.

6.4 Keyboard shortcuts

Shortcuts work on the review screen when you are not typing in a field. Press Esc to leave a field first.

Key Does
A Approve
R Reject
J Next card
K Previous card
U Undo your last action
Esc Leave the field you're typing in (so the keys above work)

Tip: a fast routine is: check the photo, fix fields, Esc, A. The next card opens by itself.

7. AI double-check suggestions

Spelling/typo double-check, advisory only: compare every field to the photo. The AI catches some misread letters and digits, but it often misses wrong words, a wrong job title or a missing state/zip. "No changes needed" does not mean the card is right. Rule-based checks (e.g. Rnbber → Rubber, Akrn → Akron, an email domain that doesn't match the website) appear as separate suggestions.

7.1 What it is

Two separate steps (round 15). 1) Reading the photos: the progress on the Scan cards page ("about N min left"). When a card shows "Added", it is already in the Review queue. 2) The AI double-check: the optional, later spelling check. The header badge "AI: N cards · all done in ~M min" counts everyone's cards waiting for this second step. You don't need to wait for it: review and approve now (approving cancels a card's waiting check). Hover the badge for this explanation. When no card is waiting, the badge says whether the AI check is on or off (only an admin can switch it, in Admin → Settings).

When a card was hard to read, a small AI model running on the scanner computer re-reads it in the background. It never changes the card by itself. It offers suggestions you accept or ignore. Cards a person has already edited or decided are never changed. Nothing leaves the computer.

7.2 What you see

On the card Meaning
AI checking… The check is running or waiting in line. Keep working; you don't need to wait for it to approve. Measured on the pilot computer: about 45 seconds of AI model time per card (median of 48 measured checks; 9 in 10 within about 75 seconds), plus any wait in the AI line: cards are checked one at a time, so with others ahead it takes longer (the card shows its place in line). Cards from different batches take turns, and a check you ask for yourself goes near the front of the line.
AI busy The model is busy with other cards. After 30 minutes of waiting the check is skipped.
AI check failed, retrying The AI checker couldn't be reached. The scanner tries again by itself up to 3 times (after 1, 2 and 3 minutes) and updates the label. You can still review and approve.
AI suggestions It found differences. Choose for each one (below).
AI-checked Finished; no changes needed, or the corrections you accepted are listed.
AI double-check skipped For example a person reviewed this card first, or it didn't finish in time. The card is fine to review as it is.

7.3 Using the suggestions

  1. Open the card. The blue AI suggestions box lists each field: what the card says Now, and what the AI suggests.
  2. For each row click Use AI value (puts the AI's value into the field) or Keep current.
  3. Check the field against the photo, then Save / Approve as usual.
  • Ask AI to double-check (or Ask AI to check again) asks for a fresh check of this card. The AI checks the saved card, so click Save changes first if you've typed anything.
  • Approved, rejected and exported cards are skipped automatically.

7.4 Turning it on or off

Admins: Admin → Settings → AI double-check: on/off. Ticked = on, unticked = off. When it is off, no AI checks run at all, including the Ask the AI button. The line underneath says whether the model is running.

At events, switch it off unless the AI checker runs on its own, dedicated machine. It checks one card at a time, at about 45–170 seconds per card on the scanner computer, and it slows the scanner down while it works. Scanning, review and export don't need it. Its suggestions are advisory only.

When it is on, the line is shared fairly: each person's cards take turns, and within one person's cards the oldest goes first. Approving or rejecting a card cancels only that card's own waiting check.

7.5 If the AI checker is offline

The scanner works normally without it; cards are just read the fast way. Signs that it's offline: the black window says "AI checker OFFLINE", and Admin → Settings says "The AI model is not running right now". To start it, double-click start-ai-checker.command on the scanner computer (if IT installed the model files). If that window says "No models folder found" or "Model file … not found", ask IT; there is nothing to fix in the scanner itself.

8. Duplicates

The scanner looks for two kinds of possible duplicate and gives you plain-language choices in an orange box on the review screen.

8.1 Same person as another scanned card

a) In the same batch, or the same photo ("duplicate scan")

The same email or phone in the same batch is treated as a duplicate scan. It blocks approval until you deal with it, and you can't keep both. Scanning the exact same photo again into the same batch is refused at upload.

The same photo in another person's or another batch is only a warning: it's listed first in the look-alike box, and you decide like any other look-alike (b).

  • Click Same person: add any new details to #X and drop this card. Any extra email or phone is copied into card #X, and this card is rejected as a duplicate. or
  • Reject one of the two cards.

b) A look-alike in another batch

For example, someone gave you their card at two different events. This only warns; it doesn't stop you approving.

  • Same person: add any new details to #X and drop this card, or
  • None of these are the same person, which marks every listed look-alike as a different person from this card in one click (and records that you confirmed it).

If one of the look-alikes is already approved in another batch with the same email or phone, Approve asks first: "Same person already approved in another batch?" with Open that card, Different person: approve this one too, or Cancel. Approve selected in the queue approves such cards too, but its summary lists each one with a warning, and lists every card it skipped and why.

Careful: only click None of these are the same person when you're sure. If they really are the same person, merge instead; otherwise the person may be imported twice.

8.2 May already be in MC Trade

The box says "Possible duplicate: this person may already be in MC Trade" and names the closest match and why (same email, same phone, similar name…).

  • Same person: update their existing MC Trade contact. The card goes into the separate …-UPDATES.xlsx file, with the MC Trade Profile ID.
  • Different person: add as new contact. The card goes into the normal new-profiles file. If its email is exactly the same as an existing MC Trade contact, it is still added, but the READ-ME and the extra-columns CSV list it under NEEDS REVIEW so the importer checks it first.

"Update existing" is switched off by default. An admin turns it on under Admin → Settings once GAC's real MC Trade contacts export has been uploaded (section 11) and one update import was tested. While it is off, only add as new contact is offered.

Your choice is shown as Decision: … with a Change link, and is written in the export's MCTradeAction column.

Important for the pilot: until an admin uploads GAC's real MC Trade contacts export (Admin → Settings → MC Trade contacts), "already in MC Trade" is checked against a SAMPLE list of 5 fake contacts, and the box says SAMPLE. Sample matches are examples only: the scanner never writes a Profile ID from them, and a card marked update existing is listed as POSSIBLE EXISTING MEMBER in the READ-ME instead of going into any import file. A card whose email matches a SAMPLE contact is still exported as a new profile (it is NOT held back, because the sample is fake); only with GAC's real contacts loaded would it be NEEDS REVIEW. The SAMPLE box is shown on the card however you open it (from the queue, with Prev/Next, or from a link).

8.3 Duplicates and exports

An export is blocked while two cards in it look like the same person, so nobody is imported twice. The Export page shows a short review list (open the Look-alikes to settle section): open each card and merge it or mark it as a different person. Admins also see Mark all as different people, which asks first.

9. Approving, rejecting, undo and changing your mind

  • Approve (A) or Reject (R) on the review screen, or tick cards and use Approve selected / Reject selected in the queue.
  • A small message at the top confirms what happened, with an Undo link.
  • ↶ Undo in the top bar (or U) reverses your most recent action: an approval, rejection, edit, merge, bulk action or archive. Press it again to go further back. It works for your own actions from the last 24 hours.
  • Changing a card that was already approved or rejected asks you to confirm and keeps the earlier decision in its History.
  • Rejected cards stay in the Rejected tab; they are never exported in the normal MC Trade file.

10. Exporting

Click Export in the top bar. Files are saved to this computer's Downloads folder; nothing is uploaded anywhere.

10.1 Export steps

  1. Which cards? Keep Approved, not yet exported (recommended). Other options: All approved cards (includes ones exported before); admins also see All cards, Pending only and Rejected only.
  2. Which batch (event)? The list starts with your batches (your most recent one is chosen for you), then other people's. Pick your event (if there is a Find a batch… box, type part of the name to shorten the list). With All batches, look-alikes from anyone's batch can block the export, so choose your own batch.
  3. Check the line underneath: "7 card(s) will be exported." If some cards were approved anyway, they are listed in red.
  4. If a red "Export is blocked" box appears, settle each pair (section 8.3) first.
  5. Click a format tile. The confirm screen is a ready-to-export sign-off: how many cards are approved, how many will be rows in the file (new profiles and updates counted separately), and which cards need a decision first, by name. Check it and click Export. The green message afterwards gives the same numbers as the rows in the files.

After an export, those cards no longer appear under "not yet exported". If details are later merged into an exported card, it is marked export it again and shows up under "not yet exported" once more.

10.2 The MC Trade import (Excel) files

Clicking MC Trade import (Excel) downloads three files (four when some cards update existing contacts), named after the batch, for example GAC-MCTrade-new-Spring-Expo-2026-10-15_1430.xlsx:

File What it is Import it?
….xlsx The import file for new profiles: only MC Trade template columns, one sheet, one row per person. Phones are written as 330-555-0181; addresses are split into street, city, state and zip; AffCode1 is CardScan-Pilot. Yes, new profiles
…-UPDATES.xlsx Only when some cards were marked update their existing MC Trade contact. Has the MC Trade ProfileID. Yes, as a separate update import
…-extra-columns.csv Everything that isn't in the template: second email, website, credentials, department, notes, reviewer, batch, MCTradeAction, NeedsAttention, and every card that was left out and why (FIX FIRST, same person as card #…). No: for checking
…-READ-ME.txt What's in the files and what to check before importing. No: read it first

Good to know:

  • Two cards of the same person are combined into one row (a mobile or fax from the second card is kept). Colleagues sharing info@ stay separate, and so do people you marked as different.
  • A person's website is in the extra-columns CSV, because Website is an organisation column in MC Trade.
  • Cards with formula-like text or HTML are left out as FIX FIRST.
  • If the READ-ME lists cards under NEEDS REVIEW (for example an uncertain MC Trade Profile ID), check those cards before importing.
  • Admins set the affiliation code (AffCode1) and phone style under Admin → Settings (section 12.2).
  • Until GAC's real MC Trade template is saved on the scanner computer (as data/mctrade_template.xlsx), the column names are the scanner's default set; the READ-ME says "UNVERIFIED headers". Day one fixes this (section 11).

10.3 Preview the MC Trade files

Preview the MC Trade files (link under the tiles) shows the rows on screen first and lets you download them: nothing is marked as exported, and look-alikes don't block it. The preview is noted in the account log (who looked at which batch). The file names start with PREVIEW- and the READ-ME starts with PREVIEW ONLY. Use it to look at the file before the real export. Don't import a preview without doing the real export too, or the cards will still show as "not yet exported".

10.4 Spreadsheet (CSV) and Contacts (vCard)

  • Spreadsheet (CSV): opens in Excel or Google Sheets, with reviewer columns and a needs_attention column. Cells that a spreadsheet would run as a formula get a leading ' (plain phone numbers like +1 330-555-0181 stay as they are).
  • Contacts (vCard): for Outlook, Gmail or a phone's contacts.

10.5 Export history

The bottom of the Export page lists every export: when, who, format, filter, batch and number of cards. Download a copy (and its READ ME, extra columns or UPDATES file) again while it is kept (30 days by default). Only the person who exported or an admin can download a copy. Show 10 more / Show all see older exports.

After importing: delete the exported files from Downloads. Treat them like any member list: don't email them outside the Chamber.

11. MC Trade import: day-one steps

For the first real import. One person owns the import (an MC Trade admin) and a second person double-checks. The dry run is built in: Export page → Check against MC Trade (dry run). The full tick-list is mctrade-dryrun/DAY-ONE-CHECKLIST.md.

Before you start

  1. In MC Trade, Admin → Manage Codes: create the affiliation code CardScan-Pilot (exact spelling). MC Trade refuses files that use a code it doesn't have.
  2. Agree with the membership lead whether event contacts come in as Prospects or Neither (MC Trade's Import screen asks Members / Prospects / Neither).

Get the real template and contacts

  1. In MC Trade, Admin → Import Profiles → Download Template Here. Give the file to the scanner admin; it becomes the column list for the exports and the dry run.
  2. In MC Trade, Profile Selector: search all active Individuals → Actions → Export All System Columns (allow pop-ups for app.atlasams.com). Save the CSV on the scanner computer only. Do the same for Organizations.
  3. A scanner admin uploads that export under Admin → Settings → MC Trade contacts (replacing the SAMPLE list). From then on "may already be in MC Trade", the Profile IDs in the UPDATES file and the dry run all use the real contacts. Remove deletes it again.

Rehearse (dry run)

  1. On the Export page pick your batch and click Check against MC Trade (dry run). It produces a match report (UPDATE / CREATE / NEEDS REVIEW / LEFT OUT per card), says which contacts it used (real or SAMPLE), and is recorded in the audit log. Its decisions are the same as the export's files and the export sign-off: one shared rule decides all three. A card that matches an existing MC Trade contact is never put in the new-profiles file: it is NEEDS REVIEW unless it is a certain “update existing” with updates switched on, and an email shared by two MC Trade profiles is always NEEDS REVIEW.
  2. In the match report, fix every FIX FIRST row in the scanner (blank name, bad email or phone, odd characters), merge any person who is there twice, then export and run again.
  3. Work through every NEEDS REVIEW row: search MC Trade for the name/email, decide, and fix the card in the scanner if needed.
  4. Check 5 UPDATE rows by hand: is it really the same person, and are the changes right? MC Trade overwrites every filled cell (blank cells don't erase anything).
  5. Check 5 CREATE rows by searching MC Trade by last name and email.
  6. Test with 2 rows first: keep two rows in a copy of each file, import, check the profiles, and delete those test profiles by hand if needed. Imports can't be undone.

Import, in this order (separate imports)

  1. New organizations file → Organizations, new profiles.
  2. New individuals file → Individuals, new profiles; relationship Employer-Employee; "Main Contact as primary" is usually no for event contacts. In MC Trade's duplicate checker, choose Create new only when you're sure it's a different person; otherwise Ignore the row and investigate.
  3. Updates file → Individuals, updates. Rows match on Profile ID, so Overwrite is pre-selected: check it.
  4. Wait for MC Trade's results email. Spot-check 10 profiles. Profile Selector → Affiliation Code = CardScan-Pilot lists everything that was imported.
  5. Delete the export and import files from Downloads and the desktop. Keep only the match report in the pilot folder.

Afterwards (10 minutes): write down which template columns differed, what the real export headers are, and how many NEEDS REVIEW rows were real duplicates versus false alarms. Send the notes to the developer.

Nothing is sent to MC Trade automatically. Live sync needs MemberClicks API credentials and is a later, developer-led step (Part C of the checklist).

12. Admin tasks

Click Admin in the top bar (admins only). It has three tabs: Reviewers, Settings and Audit log.

12.1 Reviewers (accounts)

  • Add a reviewer: fill in Full name, Username, Initials, Role (Reviewer, or Admin) and a Temporary password (10+ characters), then click Add reviewer. Give the person their username and temporary password in person; they choose their own at first sign-in.
  • Reset password: gives a new temporary password. It also lifts a sign-in lock after too many wrong passwords.
  • Deactivate: for someone who left. Their past work stays in the audit log. Reactivate brings the account back.
  • Make admin / Make reviewer: change the role.

Locked out (no admin can sign in): on the scanner computer, open a terminal in the scanner folder and run .venv/bin/python -m app.admin reset-password <username> (Mac) or .venv\Scripts\python -m app.admin reset-password <username> (Windows). It asks for the new password twice. create-admin <username> "Full Name" makes a new admin; list lists the accounts. Ask IT if you're not comfortable with a terminal.

12.2 Settings

Setting What it does
Double-check uncertain cards with the local AI model Turns the AI double-check on or off. The line below says whether the model is running.
MC Trade affiliation code (AffCode1) Written into every row of the MC Trade file. Default CardScan-Pilot. It must already exist in MC Trade, spelled exactly the same.
Allow "update existing MC Trade contact" Off by default. Turn on only after the real contacts export is uploaded and one update import was tested.
MC Trade template / contacts Upload GAC's real import template and contacts export. The last 5 templates are kept; Revert goes back to the previous one.
Phone format in the MC Trade file 330-555-0181 (GAC style, default) or +13305550181.
Keep corrected cards as test examples Off by default. When on, a copy of the photo and approved details of each corrected card is kept (bench/corrections) to measure accuracy. See the Privacy note before turning it on.
Automatically delete old card photos and export copies Retention on/off.
Delete card photos after (days) Default 30. Must be 1 to 3650. Photos of cards that are still pending are never deleted. The line below says how many photos are stored and how many will go at the next check.
Delete stored export copies after (days) Default 30.

Click Save settings after changing anything. Delete old photos now runs the clean-up straight away (it also runs every hour). The typed contact details are kept; only photos (and their thumbnails) are deleted. A card whose photo was deleted shows Photo deleted.

12.3 Archiving test data and finished batches

  • Archive one batch: Review queue → choose the batch → Archive this batch → confirm. The batch is hidden from the queue and from exports. Nothing is deleted: tick Show archived cards to see it again, and Undo brings it back.
  • Archive all test data (for example after a training session): Admin → Settings → Pilot test data → Archive all test data…, type CLEAR in capitals, and confirm. Every card in the queue (all statuses) is archived, not deleted.

12.4 Audit log

Admin → Audit log lists every sign-in and failed sign-in, decision, edit, merge, export, re-download, undo, setting change (only what changed, e.g. "AI double-check: on → off"), photo deletion and permanent deletion, with who and when. Search it (initials, #17 for a card, export, login…) or click Download as CSV.

13. Privacy and removal requests

What is kept: a photo of each card, the details printed on it, any note, who scanned/edited/approved/exported it and when, and staff sign-ins (including the computer's network address). Everything stays on the scanner computer, in its data folder.

What How long
Card photos (and their small thumbnails) Deleted after 30 days (admins can change this); never while the card is pending
Stored copies of exports (for re-download) Deleted after 30 days
"Undo" copies of card details Cleared after 2 days
Typed contact details Kept (they become Chamber contact records); archive a batch or delete a card permanently
Audit log and sign-ins Kept for accountability; personal details are removed from a card's rows after a removal request
Test examples Off by default (see Settings)

Read the full Privacy note from the link at the bottom of every page.

13.1 When someone asks to be removed (admins)

  1. In the Review queue, choose the All tab and search the person's name or email. Open the card.
  2. Click Delete permanently… and confirm with Delete permanently. This erases the photo, the details, any test-example copy and any stored export copies that contain the card. It can't be undone. The audit log keeps who scanned, approved and exported the card and when, with the personal details removed.
  3. Repeat for any other card of the same person (search again).
  4. Remove the person from MC Trade as well, and delete any exported spreadsheets that contain them.
  5. Note the request in your usual records.

Good practice: turn on disk encryption on the scanner computer (BitLocker / FileVault), use phone access only on the office Wi-Fi, and deactivate accounts of staff who leave.

14. Troubleshooting

Problem What to do
Browser says "can't connect" / "This site can't be reached" The black scanner window was closed, or the computer restarted. Double-click start again.
A batch row says "Connection to the scanner was lost" Same as above: restart the scanner, then add the photos that weren't finished again.
"Lost track of this upload (the scanner was restarted)" Add that photo again.
Every card fails to scan Tesseract isn't installed. The black window says so. See section 2.1, step 2.
The header shows "AI: N cards · all done in ~M min" That is the optional AI double-check line (a separate, later step, everyone's cards). Your cards are already in the Review queue: review them now. See 7.1.
The Review queue badge shows "3 · 2 more being read" 3 of your cards are pending; 2 more of your photos are still being read. Hover it for the counts from everyone.
"Another admin changed … after you opened this page" Two admins edited Settings (contacts file, "update existing" switch, template) at the same time. Nothing was saved: reload Admin → Settings, check their change, then try again.
"Another export of these cards is running right now" Someone (maybe you, in another tab) is already exporting this batch. Wait, then check the export history before exporting again.
"This save would clear …" The card hadn't finished loading when Save was clicked. Wait until the form shows the card, then save again.
Scanning is slow Normal when several people scan at once (5–30 s per card). Leave the batch running and review finished cards.
"AI checker OFFLINE" in the black window, or "The AI model is not running right now" in Settings Scanning still works. Start start-ai-checker.command if IT installed the model (section 7.5).
A card says AI busy or AI checking… for a long time You don't need to wait: review and approve the card. After 30 minutes the check is skipped.
"Saving your previous change first…" You clicked Save or Approve while the last save was still on its way. Wait a moment: the scanner saves what is on the form once the first save finishes. If it can't, you see "Not saved" and your typed values stay on the form. A save never disappears without a message.
"This card is archived, so it can't be changed" Archived cards are read-only. An admin can un-archive the batch if it needs more work.
Bulk approve asks one question The one dialog lists the cards that will be skipped (and why, field by field), the cards whose AI check hasn't finished, and any look-alikes approved in another batch. Choose to approve all of them, or to leave the look-alikes pending.
Approve does nothing / shows a list of problems Fix the listed fields (section 6.2). A blank first name, email without "@" or short phone can't be approved anyway.
Bulk approve skipped some cards They need fixing or have a duplicate question. Open each listed card.
Export is blocked Two cards in the export look like the same person. Use the buttons in the red box, or pick your own batch (section 8.3).
"0 card(s) will be exported" Nothing approved and not yet exported in that batch. Check the batch, or choose All approved cards.
A photo is "already scanned" It's the same photo as an earlier card in the same batch. Open that card, or click Scan it anyway if you really want a copy.
The folder button doesn't open Use Choose photos and select all (Ctrl+A / ⌘A), or drag the folder onto the box.
"Please sign in" keeps appearing Your session expired (12 hours), or an admin reset your password. Sign in again.
Red warning "signed in as a different person" Someone else signed in in this browser. Reload, check whose name is in the top bar, and sign in as yourself.
Can't sign in after wrong passwords Wait 5 minutes, or ask an admin to reset your password.
No admin can sign in See Locked out in section 12.1.
A message "Restored the edits you hadn't saved…" You were signed out with unsaved edits. Check them and save.
Photo shows "Photo deleted" The retention setting removed it. The contact details are still there.
The phone shows "connection is not private" Expected with phone access; see section 2.4, step 4.
The phone can't open the address It must be on the same office Wi-Fi, and phone access must be on (the black window says Phone access is ON).
Something else looks wrong Take a screenshot, note the card number (#), and tell the scanner admin.

15. Frequently asked questions

Does anything go to MC Trade automatically? No. You export a file and an MC Trade admin imports it. Live sync is a possible later step.

Does anything go to the internet or an AI company? No. Reading, the AI double-check and duplicate checks all run on the scanner computer.

Do I have to wait for the AI double-check before approving? No. If a check is still waiting, Approve asks whether to cancel it. If suggestions arrive after you approved, the card isn't changed.

What if I leave a card without saving? The scanner asks before you leave (Queue link, next card, sign-out). What you typed is also kept as a draft on this computer and comes back when you open the card again; Save clears it.

When does a card say "Looks good"? Only when name, company, email and website are filled in and nothing needs a second look. A card with a blank required field or a hint says Check.

What does "Check" mean on a new card? Something needs a second look on the review screen, for example a hard-to-read field or a possible duplicate. "Looks good" cards still need reviewing.

How do I say two look-alike cards are different people? Click None of these are the same person on the card. It settles every look-alike listed there in one click and is recorded. It isn't offered for a duplicate scan (same email or phone in the same batch): merge or reject one of those.

Why can't I approve a card with a formula-like value such as =SUM(1)? Spreadsheets could run it as a formula when the file is opened. Fix the field (for example remove the leading =).

Someone gave me their card at two events. What do I do? Open the second card and click Same person: add any new details to #X and drop this card. Their new details are added to the first card.

The person is already in MC Trade. What should I choose? Same person: update their existing MC Trade contact. The card goes into the UPDATES file instead of creating a new profile.

I approved the wrong card. Can I fix it? Press U or click ↶ Undo (your own actions, last 24 hours), or open the card and click Move back to pending.

I exported, then fixed a card. Does it go out again? If details were merged into an exported card, it's marked export it again and appears under "Approved, not yet exported". For other edits, export All approved cards for that batch, or ask the importer to fix it in MC Trade.

What's the Preview link on the Export page for? To look at the MC Trade Excel file without marking anything as exported.

Which file do I import into MC Trade? The .xlsx for new profiles, and the -UPDATES.xlsx as a separate update import. Never the -extra-columns.csv or -READ-ME.txt. For the first real import, follow section 11.

Can I use the scanner on my phone? Yes, once phone access is turned on (section 2.4), on the office Wi-Fi only.

How long are card photos kept? 30 days by default (never while the card is pending). The typed details are kept.

Can I delete a whole batch? Admins can archive a batch (hidden, not deleted). Permanent deletion is per card, for removal requests.

Who can see what I did? Admins, in the audit log. Your initials are also on every card you edit, approve or export, and in exports.

Where can I find this guide in the app? Click Help in the top bar (next to Password). It opens in a new tab.

I want to… Go to

Review cards Review queue → pick the batch → open a card
Approve / reject quickly A / R (after Esc), J / K next/previous, U undo
See only problem cards Review queue → Needs attention only
Export for MC Trade Export → Approved, not yet exported → your batch → MC Trade import (Excel)
Look at the MC Trade files first Export → Preview the MC Trade files
Add a team member Admin → Reviewers → Add a reviewer
Unlock someone Admin → Reviewers → Reset password
Change photo retention Admin → Settings → Privacy & retention
Hide a finished/test batch Review queue → choose batch → Archive this batch
Handle a removal request Find the card → Delete permanently… (admins)
See who did what Admin → Audit log
